      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ github.sha }}
          path: dist/

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: preview
      url: https://preview-${{ github.sha }}.github.io/${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ github.sha }}
          path: dist

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages preview branch
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
        with:
          branch: preview/${{ github.sha }}
          folder: dist
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Deploy preview for ${{ github.ref_name }}"

      - name: Create deployment status (in_progress)
        id: create_deployment
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: create
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          env: preview
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          desc: "Deploying preview for feature branch"
          task: "deploy"
          status: "in_progress"

      - name: Update deployment status (success)
        uses: bobheadxi/deployments@v1
        with:
          step: update
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          env: preview
          deployment_id: ${{ steps.create_deployment.outputs.deployment_id }}
          status: "success"
          desc: "Deployment succeeded"
